name: Bilateral Limit 4
definition: Characteristics and values set for a bilateral limit, including the counterparty upon which the limit applies.

CounterpartyIdentification.name: Counterparty Identification
CounterpartyIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a member within a system, assigned using the member identification scheme of the system.

LimitAmount.name: Limit Amount
LimitAmount.definition: Amount of money of the limit, expressed in an eligible currency.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies if a limit is a debit limit or a credit limit.

BilateralBalance.name: Bilateral Balance
BilateralBalance.definition: Balance calculated with regard to one member in the system.
